item.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU) for a period of five years upto 31.03.2031. The scheme provides credit guarantee coverage to the Lending Institutions through National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC) against default risk.
item.title: Cabinet approves continuation of Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units
